headline: Sappi Integrates Third-Party Renewable Electricity into Energy Mix
summary: Sappi added third-party renewable electricity to its energy mix through a partnership with electricity traders, supplying solar generation to one of South Africa's major industrial groups.
why: Sappi is a major global producer of dissolving pulp, paper, and paperpackaging, making energy procurement and cost efficiency critical factors for its industrial operations.

impacts.name: Sappi
impacts.why: Diversifying energy sources impacts long-term operational costs and sustainability metrics.
